name: Nordic Walking

instructions.description: Stand with poles angled behind and straps fitted correctly.
Walk forward while planting each pole near the opposite foot.
Push the pole backward to assist arm swing and propulsion.
Maintain an upright posture and steady breathing.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Nordic Walking — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Use poles adjusted to a comfortable height.
